S1.why: The bracket already points at the five tiles, so the count and 'miễn phí' are enough; adding 'cutling' would break the 12-character budget.

S2.why: An invitation to keep going, 'thoải mái' is the everyday word for 'without worrying'; no mention of a limit or a price, which the button carries.

S3.s: Bạn đã dùng hết %lld cutling miễn phí. Chúng vẫn miễn phí và dùng được như cũ.
S3.back: You have used up 5 cutling free. They still free and use-able as before.
S3.why: 'dùng hết' is the plain 'used up'; 'như cũ' (as before) reassures that nothing changes; lower-case 'cutling' as the item noun, as the vocabulary's iCloud sentence writes it.

S4.s: Bạn được lưu %lld cutling miễn phí.
S4.why: 'được' states an allowance the person has, warmer than 'có thể' (can), and avoids a 'you can' sentence.

S5.s: Bạn đã dùng %lld trong số %lld cutling miễn phí.
S5.back: You have used 3 in number-of 5 cutling free.
S5.why: 'X trong số Y' is the natural Vietnamese count of part against whole; numbers come in the same order as the variables, so no positional forms needed.

S6.why: A noun phrase like the other bold row heads; Vietnamese has no plural, so 'cutling' stays unchanged.

S7.s: Lưu đến %@ cutling văn bản và %lld cutling hình ảnh.
S7.back: Save up-to 5.000 cutling text and 500 cutling image.
S7.why: Uses the vocabulary's own names for the two kinds, 'cutling văn bản' and 'cutling hình ảnh', so the menu and this sheet name them the same way.

S8.why: Vietnamese lists with commas and 'và' before the last item, no serial comma.

S9.s: Mua một lần, dùng trên mọi thiết bị đăng nhập Apple Account của bạn.
S9.back: Buy one time, use on every device signed-in Apple Account of you.
S9.why: Echoes the vocabulary's iCloud sentence ('mọi thiết bị đã đăng nhập Apple Account của bạn') and keeps 'Apple Account' in English as that file does.

S10.why: Two short clauses side by side is how Vietnamese states a one-time deal; 'dùng mãi' says nothing recurs without the stiff 'duy nhất'.

S11.s: Không thuê bao, không quảng cáo, không cần tạo tài khoản.
S11.back: No subscription, no advertising, no need create account.
S11.why: 'thuê bao' is the everyday word for a subscription; 'tạo tài khoản' avoids repeating 'đăng ký', which would also read as 'subscribe'.

S12.why: The wording Vietnamese iOS apps commonly use for the App Store restore action; 'giao dịch mua' is reused in S20, S24 and S26 so a purchase has one name.

S13.why: 'Đang' marks an action in progress; single ellipsis character.

S14.s: Mở khóa trọn đời với giá %@
S14.why: 'trọn đời' (lifetime) is the term Vietnamese buyers know from one-time app purchases; 'với giá' is how a price is stated on a buy button.

S15.why: 'Mở khóa trọn đời' is 16 characters, over the 14 budget, so the bare verb carries the action until the price arrives.

S16.why: The usual Vietnamese 'maybe later': putting it off, not saying no.

S17.why: The plain verb iOS uses in Vietnamese for close buttons.

S18.why: Short and warm: everything, room included, now belongs to the person.

S19.s: Cảm ơn bạn đã mua. Cutling do một người làm ra, và bạn vừa giúp người ấy làm tiếp.
S19.back: Thank you have bought. Cutling by one person made, and you just helped that person make on.
S19.why: Says the thanks, then the plain fact of one maker; 'giúp người ấy làm tiếp' is spoken Vietnamese for keeping someone going, no 'ủng hộ' boilerplate.

S20.s: Chào mừng bạn trở lại. Giao dịch mua trước đây đã được khôi phục.
S20.back: Welcome you return. Transaction purchase before-here already got restored.
S20.why: 'Chào mừng bạn trở lại' is the standard warm welcome back; 'giao dịch mua' and 'khôi phục' match the S12 link the person just tapped.

S21.s: Đã dùng %lld trong số %lld cutling miễn phí
S21.back: Already used 3 in number-of 5 cutling free
S21.why: Same count shape as S5 so the spoken and printed versions agree; no subject needed when spoken over the tiles.

S22.s: Bạn có %lld cutling. Giờ có chỗ cho %@ cutling.
S22.back: You have 5 cutling. Now have room for 5.000 cutling.
S22.why: Vietnamese nouns do not inflect for number, so one form reads right for 1, 2, 5 and 21.

S23.s: Đã mở khóa Cutling. Giờ có chỗ cho %@ cutling.
S23.back: Already unlocked Cutling. Now have room for 5.000 cutling.
S23.why: Capital 'Cutling' is the app, lower-case 'cutling' the items, as the vocabulary separates them; the second sentence repeats S22's wording.

S24.s: Giao dịch mua chưa hoàn tất
S24.why: 'chưa' (not yet) is calm and blames no one, and leaves room to try again.

S25.s: Hiện không kết nối được với App Store. Bạn thử lại sau ít phút nhé.
S25.back: Currently not connect able with App Store. You try again after few minutes okay.
S25.why: Names the cause, then the way out; the soft 'nhé' keeps it friendly without an exclamation.

S26.s: App Store chưa xác nhận giao dịch mua này.
S26.back: App Store not-yet confirm transaction purchase this.
S26.why: States what happened with App Store as the subject, so the person is not blamed.

S27.s: Apple Account đang đăng nhập trên thiết bị này chưa từng mua Cutling.
S27.back: Apple Account currently signed-in on device this not-yet ever bought Cutling.
S27.why: 'chưa từng' is the natural 'has never'; the account is the subject, which points at the likely fix (another account) without lecturing.

S28.s: Bản miễn phí lưu được %lld cutling. Mở khóa Cutling một lần để lưu bao nhiêu tùy thích.
S28.back: Version free save able 5 cutling. Unlock Cutling one time to save how-many as-you-like.
S28.why: 'bản miễn phí' is the usual name for the free version; 'bao nhiêu tùy thích' is the idiom for as many as you like.

S29.why: A compact pair fits the 18-character subtitle; 'Đã dùng' would push it to 20.

K1.s: Đã hết %lld miễn phí, chạm để mở khóa
K1.back: Already out-of 5 free, tap to unlock
K1.why: 'chạm' is Apple's Vietnamese for tap; drops 'cutling' to stay inside 38 characters, matching S1's '5 miễn phí'.

M1.why: Verb-led and sentence case, as Vietnamese Mac window titles are written.

M2.why: Same command as M1 with the ellipsis character because it opens a window.

M3.why: A row label naming the free items with the vocabulary's item word.

M4.why: A slash pair is the compact count Vietnamese settings show; M3 already says what is counted.

M5.why: 'Đã' marks a finished state, the usual status wording.

M6.s: Mua một lần để mở khóa Cutling trên iPhone, iPad và Mac.
M6.back: Buy one time to unlock Cutling on iPhone, iPad and Mac.
M6.why: Same 'mua một lần' as S9 and the same device list as S8.

M7.s: Đã mở khóa trên iPhone, iPad và Mac với Apple Account này.
M7.back: Already unlocked on iPhone, iPad and Mac with Apple Account this.
M7.why: 'Apple Account này' (this Apple Account) points at the account signed in on this Mac; device list as in S8.

M8.s: Bạn mua Cutling từ khi ứng dụng còn tính phí, nên Cutling vẫn được mở khóa. Cảm ơn bạn.
M8.back: You bought Cutling from when app still charged fee, so Cutling still got unlocked. Thank you.
M8.why: 'từ khi … còn tính phí' (back when it still cost money) is how a Vietnamese speaker says it, plainer than 'trước khi miễn phí'; the thanks comes last.
